# MY PG - Full Documentation
> Complete reference for MY PG - India's leading PG management software | https://manageyourpg.com

## Product Overview
MY PG (ManageYourPG) is a comprehensive SaaS platform designed specifically for Indian PG (Paying Guest) accommodation owners, landlords, and property managers. The platform digitizes and automates all aspects of PG operations including rent collection, tenant management, room/bed tracking, expense management, and operational reporting.

## Website Structure
- `/` — Homepage with Hero, KeyFacts, TrustStats, Features, Screenshots, Pricing, Careers, Property Listings, Service Areas, About, Why Choose, Testimonials, FAQ, Contact sections
- `/features` — Full listing of all 17 PG management software features with detailed problem/solution/benefit/use-case sections
- `/features/:slug` — Individual feature detail pages (17 total) including rent collection, tenant management, digital check-in, occupancy management, bed management, multi-property management, and more
- `/why-choose` — Comprehensive page covering 7 reasons to choose MY PG with problem/solution/benefits/use-case format
- `/list-your-pg` — Page for PG owners to list their properties for tenant discovery
- `/about` — About Us page with company mission, stats, and values
- `/careers` — Careers page with job openings, application form, and company stats
- `/press` — Press kit with media resources, brand assets, and company information
- `/terms` — Terms and Conditions
- `/privacy` — Privacy Policy

## Features (Detailed)

### Rent Management
- Automated rent reminders via WhatsApp and SMS
- UPI, Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm integration for payments
- Digital rent receipts with automatic generation
- Payment tracking dashboard with pending/overdue status
- Late payment notifications and escalation

### Tenant Management
- Digital tenant profiles with photo, contact, and KYC documents
- Aadhaar, PAN, address proof upload and storage
- Room/bed assignment with move-in/move-out tracking
- Security deposit tracking with auto-refund calculation
- Police verification and background screening integration
- Tenant communication through app and WhatsApp

### Property Management
- Multi-property support from single dashboard
- Room and bed configuration (single/double/triple sharing)
- Real-time occupancy tracking
- Per-room and per-bed pricing
- Floor-wise and building-wise management

### Expense Management
- Expense categorization (maintenance, food, staff, utilities)
- Monthly expense reports and trends
- Vendor payment tracking
- Budget setting and alerts

### Operations
- Food and mess management (meal plans, dietary preferences, timings)
- Cleaning and maintenance scheduling (room, common areas, pest control)
- CCTV camera integration with live monitoring
- Notice board for tenant announcements
- Self check-in/check-out requests

### Analytics & Reports
- Revenue reports by property, month, or year
- Occupancy rate tracking
- Rent collection efficiency reports
- Expense vs revenue analysis
- Exportable reports (PDF/Excel)

## Schema Markup
The website includes comprehensive JSON-LD structured data:
- SoftwareApplication schema with aggregate rating (4.8/5, 5000+ reviews)
- Organization schema with contact details and social profiles
- FAQPage schema with 10+ frequently asked questions and answers
- JobPosting schema for Sales Executive position
- Product schema with pricing offers
- LocalBusiness schemas for each major city
- HowTo schema for product setup
- VideoObject schema for product demo
- SpeakableSpecification for voice search optimization
